findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_ad_details, generate_clips, clips_status, assemble_video, assemble_status · Private data: sign_up, assemble_video · Public sink: whoami · Destructive: get_competitor_ads, sign_up, roadmap_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_ad_details, generate_clips, clips_status, assemble_video, assemble_status · Private data: sign_up, assemble_video · Public sink: whoami · Destructive: get_competitor_ads, sign_up, roadmap_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
